items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: John Ibach was a beloved member of our band.

ctx.x: Yeah. A very interesting guy. Tell me about John Ibach a little bit.

John Ibach was a beloved member of our band. I served on the Student Council with him as an undergraduate. He was a very fervent player, very passionate about it. And he has done a lot for jazz piano in Florida, he was known as Dr. Jazz in Jacksonville, and he sponsored some Marian McPartland concerts. He was well known by professionals and by audiences. But we loved him. He was a funny guy. And a dear man, a truly kind man. And we really missed him. I saw him a couple of times down in Florida when he was…
Do you see replacements in line for the All-Stars?
